page.title: Ironman Marbella 2030: Yacht Charter Recovery Day for Athletes

data.meta_description: Recover in style after Ironman Marbella 2030 with a luxury yacht charter from Puerto Banús. Ice baths, healthy cuisine, and sea views from €749.
data.summary: After crossing the Ironman Marbella 2030 finish line, accelerate recovery with a private yacht charter from Puerto Banús. This guide covers the best boats for athlete groups, onboard recovery amenities, and how to book a post-race day on the Mediterranean.

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) from €749/2h including skipper, drinks, and snacks.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman Marbella 2030 finish line?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is approximately 3 km (5 minutes by taxi) from the Marbella promenade finish area. Most athletes stay in hotels along the Golden Mile, making the port an easy post-race destination.

faq.q: Can we bring our own recovery equipment (foam rollers, ice vests) on board?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring personal recovery gear. Our boats have ample deck and cabin space. We recommend the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge for larger groups needing room for mats and coolers.

faq.q: What is the best boat for a group of 10–12 athletes?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a spacious flybridge, sun pads, and a free jet ski – perfect for active recovery. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) is a more intimate option with a shaded cockpit.

faq.q: Do you offer any special recovery amenities like ice baths or massage?
faq.a: We don't provide ice baths or masseuses directly, but you can bring portable ice baths and coolers. We can also recommend local sports massage therapists who can meet you at the port before departure.

faq.q: How much does a half-day charter cost for an Ironman recovery group?
faq.a: Tier A boats start at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

faq.q: What is the typical weather in Marbella in April 2030?
faq.a: April in Marbella averages 18–22°C air temperature with 8–10 hours of sunshine. The sea is 16–18°C – cool enough for therapeutic immersion but pleasant for cruising. Light jacket recommended for early morning departures.

faq.q: Can we depart from a different marina closer to the race route?
faq.a: All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. However, Marbella Marina is only 2 km east. We can arrange a taxi or minibus transfer for your group. Contact us via WhatsApp for logistics support.

faq.q: Is it possible to book a sunset recovery cruise after the race?
faq.a: Absolutely. Sunset in April 2030 is around 20:45. A 2-hour charter from 18:30 to 20:30 lets you watch the sun dip behind La Concha mountain while you float in the bay. Perfect for post-race relaxation.

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2030 is a monumental achievement. Your body has just endured 3.8 km of swimming, 180 km of cycling, and 42.2 km of running along the Costa del Sol. Now comes the most important part of race week: recovery. A private yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers a unique, science-backed way to accelerate muscle repair, reduce inflammation, and celebrate with your support crew – all while floating on the Mediterranean. Here's how to plan your post-Ironman recovery day on the water.

Why a yacht charter beats a hotel pool for Ironman recovery

Active recovery – low-impact movement in a cool environment – is proven to reduce delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS) faster than complete rest. A yacht charter gives you controlled exposure to 16–18°C sea water (ideal for cold-water immersion), gentle walking on deck, and zero-impact swimming in calm bays. Unlike a crowded hotel pool, you control the temperature, the schedule, and the noise. Plus, the gentle rocking of the boat can lower cortisol levels. All our charters include a licensed skipper, so you don't lift a finger – your only job is to recover.

Best boats for athlete groups: capacity, space, and recovery features

Choose your vessel based on group size and desired level of activity. For small teams of 5–8 athletes, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax, €749/2h) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax, same price) offer intimate decks with sun pads and shaded cockpits. For squads of 10–12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, from €4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski – ideal for active recovery rides – plus a large flybridge for stretching and foam rolling. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) provides a more sheltered aft deck, perfect for post-race naps. All boats have onboard coolers for your ice vests, electrolyte drinks, and recovery snacks.

Onboard recovery amenities: what's included and what to bring

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a welcome pack of water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. We also provide safety equipment and Spanish IVA (21%). For Ironman-specific recovery, we recommend bringing: a portable ice bath (collapsible tubs work well on the aft deck), compression boots (boat has 230V outlets), foam rollers, and your own nutrition. The sea temperature in April averages 16–18°C – perfect for 5–10 minute cold-water immersions between the Cala del Faro and Cabopino beaches. Your skipper can anchor in calm, shallow spots for safe entry.

Sample recovery itinerary: 4-hour post-race charter

14:00 – Board at Puerto Banús (10-min taxi from race finish). Stow gear, meet your skipper, and receive safety briefing.
14:15 – Depart west towards Estepona. Gentle cruise at 8–10 knots while you hydrate and eat.
14:45 – Anchor at Cala Cortés. Shallow, calm water (4–6m depth). Cold-water immersion session: 3 x 3-minute dips with 2-minute rest.
15:30 – Light stretching on the flybridge. Use the sun pads for hip flexor and hamstring release.
16:00 – Cruise back past the Golden Mile. Enjoy the view of La Concha mountain while sipping a recovery smoothie (bring your own blender – we have power).
17:30 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark feeling refreshed, not stiff.

How to book your Ironman Marbella 2030 recovery charter

Reserve early – Ironman weekend sees high demand for private charters. Browse our full fleet and select your preferred boat. For groups of 10+, we recommend the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge. All bookings require a 50% deposit via bank transfer or card; balance due 7 days before departure. We can also arrange post-race massage therapists to meet you at the port. For last-minute requests (within 48 hours), message us on WhatsApp – we'll do our best to accommodate. Cancellations made 14+ days before the charter receive a full refund.
